metas.name: The Law of Beasts
metas.description: When the case of a child serial killer resurfaces after 25 years as an unresolved legal and social problem, two former friends are forced to confront the choices that broke their friendship and shaped their lives.

metas.name: Os 12 Signos de Valentina
metas.description: Follows Valentina whose boyfriend cheats on her and she's told their problem was astronomical incompatibility, so she determines to date men of every zodiac sign and share her experiences in a videocast.

metas.name: Sex/Life
metas.description: A suburban mother of two takes a fantasy-charged trip down memory lane that sets her very married present on a collision course with her wild child past.

metas.name: One Punch Man: Wanpanman
metas.description: Saitama, a superhero who can defeat any foe with a single punch, battles boredom as he searches for a worthy opponent in a world plagued by monsters.

metas.name: The Circle
metas.description: Players start off isolated in an apartment, and with their online interactions as their only means of any communication. The players use a social media platform called "The Circle".

metas.name: Fading Grandeur
metas.description: Desperate to sell his crumbling mansion, a fallen marquis tries to make a quick deal with a charming yet mysterious millionaire who has her own agenda.

metas.name: Collateral
metas.description: When a pizza delivery driver is shot dead in south London, a tenacious detective goes after the people traffickers behind his murder and unravels a conspiracy that goes to the top.

metas.name: The Ramparts of Ice
metas.description: Weighed down by memories she can't shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm's length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.

metas.name: Sword Art Online
metas.description: In the near future, a Virtual Reality Massive Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game (VRMMORPG) called Sword Art Online has been released where players control their avatars with their bodies using a piece of technology called Nerve Gear. One day, players discover they cannot log out, as the game creator is holding them captive unless they reach the 100th floor of the game's tower and defeat the final boss. However, if they die in the game, they die in real life. Their struggle for survival starts now...

metas.name: Prime Suspect
metas.description: Highly skilled Detective Inspector Jane Tennison battles to prove herself in a male dominated world.

metas.name: The Prisoner
metas.description: After resigning, a secret agent is abducted and taken to what looks like an idyllic village, but is really a bizarre Kafkaesque prison. His warders demand information. He gives them nothing, but only tries to escape.

metas.name: Garth Marenghi's Darkplace
metas.description: When the Hellmouth opens beneath Darkplace Hospital in downtown Romford, kiddy doctor, Vietnam veteran and ex-warlock Dr. Rick Dagless M.D. is the only man who can close it. Joined by best buddy Dr. Lucien Sanchez, fiery hospital boss Thornton Reed, and woman Liz Asher, Dagless must fight the forces of Darkness while dealing with the burden of day-to-day admin. From the chilling pen of best-selling horror writer Garth Marenghi comes this lost masterpiece of televisual terror. Dare you enter Garth's Darkplace?

metas.name: This Old House
metas.description: TV's original home-improvement show, following one whole-house renovation over several episodes.

metas.name: 9-1-1: Nashville
metas.description: Explores the personal & professional lives of Tennessee first responders who are thrust into the most shocking and heart-stopping situations, day after day.

metas.name: The Resident
metas.description: A tough, brilliant senior resident guides an idealistic young doctor through his first day, pulling back the curtain on what really happens, both good and bad, in modern-day medicine.

metas.name: HIP - High Intellectual Potential
metas.description: Morgane is 38-years old, has three children, two exes and an IQ of 160; her destiny as a cleaner is turned upside-down when her extraordinary abilities are spotted by the police who offer her a job as a consultant.

metas.name: Billions
metas.description: Shrewd, savvy U.S. Attorney Chuck Rhoades and the brilliant, ambitious hedge fund king Bobby "Axe" Axelrod are on an explosive collision course, with each using all of his considerable smarts, power and influence to outmaneuver the other. The stakes are in the billions in this timely, provocative series.

metas.name: 90 Day: Hunt for Love
metas.description: Features eight singles from the 90 Day universe who are ready to embark on a quest for love once again, joined by fresh, new faces and romantic hopefuls.

metas.name: Video Nasty
metas.description: Three mostly normal, slightly weird teens go on an epic quest for a cult VHS collection. But on the way, they somehow get mixed up in a murder.

metas.name: A Body in the Basement
metas.description: These chilling stories of murder hit terrifyingly close to home -- each a real-life tale about the last thing anyone wants to find in their basement, a dead body. Every episode will make one think twice before ever stepping foot in the basement again.

metas.name: Passenger
metas.description: A close-knit community is sent spinning on its axis following a series of strange and unnatural crimes.

metas.name: The Bad Skin Clinic
metas.description: Dermatologist Dr. Emma Craythorne diagnoses and treats patients from around the United Kingdom who have extreme skin conditions.

metas.name: Real World/Road Rules Challenge
metas.description: Alumni from reality TV and other forms of entertainment and first time cast members live together and compete against one another in physical and mental challenges for cash prizes.

metas.name: Small Town Trouble: Texas
metas.description: Set in Boerne, Texas, the series follows a charming yet unconventional group of mothers and social insiders and their husbands as conservative small-town values collide with forbidden attraction, messy friendships, and shocking secrets. Here, perception is everything, temptation is everywhere, and the truth is never as buttoned-up as it looks.

metas.name: Vanderpump Rules
metas.description: Best known as one of The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills, Lisa Vanderpump opens the salacious kitchen doors of her exclusive Hollywood restaurant and lounge, SUR.
